findings.highlight: ...I'll fight to bring Sakura back. If you're going to stop me, then I'll do everything I can to eliminate you."
findings.evidenceJa: ……俺は桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う。おまえがその邪魔をするなら、全力で排除するだけだ」
findings.governingReading: 桜を取り戻す為に桜と戦う explicitly combines fighting Sakura with recovering her.
findings.explanation: Explicit fight against Sakura loses its target.

findings.highlight: ...Rider's going off to fight on her own. She can't return to her Master, nor does she want to rely on us.
findings.evidenceJa: ……桜の下に帰らず、かといって俺たちに頼る事もなく、ライダーは単身戦いに赴いていった。
findings.governingReading: Rider departs to fight alone, neither returning to Sakura nor relying on Shirou's group, after rejecting his proposed means of saving her.
findings.explanation: Rider's departure without returning to Sakura becomes an inability to return to her Master. The English supplies a constraint where the passage reports her course of action.
